newsitem.title: USA: Total System sees 1997 earnings growth over 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Total System sees 1997 earnings growth over 20 pct.

text.p: Total System Services Inc said on Thursday it expects to achieve overall earnings growth greater than 20 percent for full-year 1997, based on its first-half performance.

Total reported second-quarter earnings per share of $0.08, up from $0.06 for the year-ago period. For the six-month period, Total's earnings per share were $0.14, compared with $0.11 for the first half of 1996.
Total processes credit, debit, commercial and private-label cards, serving institutions throughout the United States, Canada and Mexico.
